name: Call of Water
summary: Your path to the Call of Water begins in Thunder Bluff, where a shaman is ready to seek the element of water. To meet Islen Waterseer, you travel east across the Barrens to its eastern shore. The meeting begins a spiritual journey toward the Water Totem.

sections.title: A Summons from the Bluff
sections.body: You have mastered earth and fire, and now your trainers judge you ready to study water. In Thunder Bluff, Xanis Flameweaver recognizes when you have shown the discipline to approach this cleansing element. Your path leads away from Mulgore's mesas and east across the dry plains of the Barrens.

sections.title: The Hermit of the Coast
sections.body: You find Islen Waterseer in a fishing shack on the eastern coast, south of Ratchet and the mouth of the Southfury River. She lives apart from the settlements, beside the open ocean. Islen reads your readiness in the elements around you. Earth, wind, and fire already touch your spirit, and she prepares you for trials that will teach you the purity of water.

faq.q: Who sends me on this journey?
aliases: where to get call of water tb
faq.answer: A shaman trainer in Thunder Bluff, such as Xanis Flameweaver, sends you once your training has brought you to the rites of water.
Islen Waterseer lives in a fishing hut on the eastern coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet and the Southfury River's mouth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Call of Water trial?
faq.answer: The trial begins a shaman's communion with water, testing your understanding of its purity and leading toward the Water Totem.

faq.q: Do other Horde races receive this same instruction?
faq.answer: Tauren shaman receive the summons in Thunder Bluff. Orc and troll shaman in Orgrimmar and Durotar receive similar calls to find Islen Waterseer on the Barrens coast.

faq.q: What elements must a shaman master before water?
faq.answer: Before seeking water, you commune with earth and fire. Islen also sees earth, wind, and fire touching your spirit before water reveals its purity.

faq.q: What happens after finding Islen Waterseer?
faq.answer: Finding Islen completes your journey from Thunder Bluff. She then sets further tasks across Kalimdor to help you understand and purify water.

angles.text: As a shaman, you move from early elemental trials toward the cleansing, restorative powers of water and tide.
As a tauren, you leave Mulgore's sheltered plains from Thunder Bluff and travel into the wider reaches of Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you share shamanic traditions that link orc, troll, and tauren spiritualists.
